audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 2, 3 and First item were given to Yorick and 4-5 and 6 called 'Skill', contradicting the packet chart, the 52.6% win rate and the page's own why-strings, which give Kled every row from 2 to first item.
audit.why: Yorick before Maiden has no way to answer the level 2-3 E-W-E all-in; he reclaims the lane only at two-plus items with a full ghoul wave.
audit.corrected: Levels 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and First item flipped to Kled in both layers; 2+ items stays Yorick.

audit.why: Kled: W at 2, full pattern at 3, R at 6, Eclipse. Yorick: level 6 Eulogy of the Isles (160/130/100s) and two-plus items of ghoul swarm.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page swaps Yorick's W and E in seven places — it repeatedly calls his E a 'mist cage' that traps your dash ('before his E mist can cage your dash', 'knock him out of his own E cage', 'cage you with E and trap you with W', 'Cage you in E mist'). E does not cage anything.
audit.why: Mourning Mist (E) is a thrown globule that reduces armour, damages, slows and marks you — and it is what makes his ghouls sprint at you. The cage is Dark Procession (W), a destructible wall on a 12-20s cooldown. Getting these backwards means the reader dodges the wrong ability: the slow-mark is the one you eat, the wall is the one you must not stand inside.
audit.corrected: W named as the wall/cage, E named as the armour-shred slow-mark, throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal named as an item with no timing, and Last Rites' auto-reset tell is absent.
audit.why: Last Rites (Q) is a 4-6s auto-attack reset that also heals him — the wind-up is the tell, and Grievous Wounds has to be applied before the extended trade, not after.
audit.corrected: Both written into dosFull[1].d and the cooldown field.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'early' field opens in first person ('neither of us wants to commit').
audit.why: The rest of the site is second person.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in second person at the same length.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — neither of us wants to commit, so just deny his Q last-hits and protect Skaarl's health bar. The lane flips at 2 and 3: once your W shotgun shots and the E-W-E re-dash are online, you out-burst a Yorick who has no ghouls or Maiden yet. Throw Q to stick the trap and slow, yank yourself in, and unload before his E mist can cage your dash. Dodge his E — if he lands the cage on you while dismounted, his autos and ghouls will chunk you, so all-in BEFORE he can box you.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — neither of you wants to commit, so deny his Last Rites last-hits and protect Skaarl's health bar. The lane flips at 2 and 3: once your W shotgun shots and the E-W-E re-dash are online, you out-burst a Yorick who has no ghouls or Maiden yet. Throw Q to stick the trap and slow, yank yourself in, and unload before Dark Procession (W) walls off your dash. Dodge Mourning Mist (E) — it shreds your armour, slows you and sends his ghouls sprinting at you.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are still yours. Your remount sustain and stacked W procs let you trade through his ghoul chip, and your percent-HP Q keeps shredding him even as he gets tankier. At 6 your R is the kill button: charge him to knock him out of his own E cage, or use it to dive past Maiden when he's zoning. First item with Sheen burst is your peak — force every all-in here and end the lane before his ghoul army snowballs the side waves.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are still yours. Your remount sustain and stacked W procs let you trade through his ghoul chip, and your percent-HP Q keeps shredding him even as he gets tankier. At 6 your R is the kill button: charge straight over his Dark Procession wall, or dive past Maiden when he's zoning. First item with Sheen burst is your peak — force every all-in here and end the lane before his ghoul army snowballs the side waves.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for the ghouls. Don’t get caged. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Dark Procession (W), 12-20s: a destructible wall that boxes you in for the ghouls. Fight where he cannot ring you. - Mourning Mist (E), 8-12s: armour shred, slow and a mark his ghouls sprint toward. - Last Rites (Q), 4-6s: an auto reset that heals him.

edits.before: Track Yorick's Dark Procession (Cage): Traps you for the ghouls. Don’t get caged. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Dark Procession (W) is the cage, 12-20s — it is destructible, so break a segment rather than waiting it out. Mourning Mist (E) shreds armour and marks you for the ghouls. Last Rites (Q) is an auto reset that heals.

edits.before: Beartrap Yorick when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Apply Grievous Wounds before the trade — Last Rites heals him on every reset auto. Then Beartrap and rip the full mounted combo.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The wall is destructible — attack one segment instead of standing in it while ghouls chew you.

notes: Two real problems fixed. (1) The chart gave Yorick levels 2-3 and first item against the packet, the win rate and the page's own why-strings. (2) Yorick's W and E were swapped in seven places: the page called Mourning Mist (E) a 'mist cage' that traps your dash, when E is an armour-shred slow-mark and the cage is Dark Procession (W). That would have had readers dodging the wrong ability. Whether the ghoul-mark from E can be cleansed is not in the kit data and is not asserted.
